title: Wingback Beds
descriptionHtml:
When choosing a velvet wingback bed, look for a solid wood frame, wings deep enough to lean against and a dense velvet that holds the panel lines, and measure the wall, as the wings add width. Our wingback beds are handmade to order in Dewsbury in Plush Velvet or other fabrics, such as the Mayfair Wingback Bed from £285.99 and the Roxy Curved Wingback Bed from £337.99. Free swatches available.

A wingback bed has a tall upholstered headboard with side wings that curve forward to frame the bed. Panel wingback beds pair a padded panel front with forward-curving wings. Ours are handmade to order in Dewsbury on solid wood frames, in your choice of fabric from Single to Super King, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Not quite right? For a flat padded headboard see panel beds; for deep buttoning see Chesterfield beds; for a headboard only see headboards.

Wingback bed buying guide

Why choose a wingback?

The wings give you something soft to lean against when sitting up, and a tall winged headboard makes the bed the focal point of the room. It suits a plain wall behind the bed.

Our wingback styles

  • Panel wingbacks — Mayfair Wingback Bed, Mini Line Wingback Bed, Eagle Regency Wingback Panel Bed and Eagle Harlington Wingback Bed.
  • Curved wingbacks — Roxy Curved Wingback Bed, Curved Wingback Bed, Romeo Wingback Bed and Hilton Wingback Bed.
  • Buttoned wingbacks — Eagle Royal Chesterfield Wingback Bed, with deep button tufting.
  • Wingback with storage — Oxford Wingback Storage Bed with Drawers, plus designs offered with an ottoman base.
  • For children — see wingback designs in our kids beds.

Measuring for a wingback

The wings add to the width of the headboard, so measure the wall and leave room for bedside tables. Headboard height varies by design; check the product page for exact measurements.

Upholstered to order in Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé. Velvet shows off the curves and panel detail particularly well.

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between a wingback and a panel bed?

A panel bed has a flat headboard divided into padded sections. A wingback adds forward-facing side wings. See our panel beds.

Can I get a wingback bed with storage?

Yes. Some designs come with drawers and others are offered with a gas-lift ottoman base — see storage beds.

How long does delivery take, and can I return a bed?

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging, and a faulty item is replaced free or fully refunded. See our returns policy.

What warranty do I get?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty. See our warranty page for the full terms.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. We post free fabric swatches so you can check colour and texture in your own light. Request free swatches.

Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire · solid wood frames · free delivery across Great Britain (Northern Ireland £90), usually in 3–5 working days · 14-day free returns · 5-year warranty · free fabric swatches · Klarna and Clearpay available.
